title: After oil, the food bill
description: How an energy shock reaches the supermarket, and who pays for it

title: Finland's inflation cushion: 2.7% against the euro area's 3.8%
description: Finland's harmonised inflation was 2.7% in September 2026, 1.1 points below the euro area's 3.8%. Electricity held Finnish prices down while energy drove euro area inflation up.

title: Global public debt heads past 100% of GDP, and the interest bill now drives it
description: Governments around the world owe more than at almost any time in modern history. The IMF now expects global public debt to exceed 100 percent of global GDP by 2030.

title: Finland tops the EU jobless table. Is it as bad as it looks?
description: Finland has the EU's highest unemployment rate, yet its employment rate is just below the EU average. Students, a large labour force and a widening gap for people born abroad: what Eurostat and Statistics Finland data show.

title: The 1% US tax is not the biggest cost of sending money to Kenya
description: Before the US tax, paying cash to send US$200 from the USA to Kenya cost twice as much as a card or bank transfer. The costliest routes into Kenya are regional. What World Bank price data show.

title: A record month, a shrinking US corridor: what Kenya's 2026 remittance data are telling us
description: Kenya's remittances hit a record US$451.8m in August 2026, yet the annual total is flat as US flows fall. What CBK data show, and what they can't.
